UNIFIED user interaction tool - handles all interaction types in ONE function.

MODES:
- 'confirmation': Yes/No with cost/risk transparency
- 'choice': Multiple options (single or multi-select)
- 'input': Free-form text/number input with optional suggestions
- 'control': Pause/Stop/Explain/Continue buttons for long operations

BUTTON BEHAVIORS:
- 'submit': Click button → send immediately to AI
- 'insert': Click button → populate input field (user can edit before sending)

CONTROL BUTTONS (NEW!):
- Pause: AI stops, shows options (Continue/Modify/Explain)
- Stop: AI stops, shows progress with resource links
- Explain: AI provides detailed update with links to files/URLs
- Continue: AI resumes from pause

USE THIS INSTEAD OF:
- request_user_confirmation() → mode='confirmation'
- request_user_choice() → mode='choice'
- request_user_input() → mode='input'

EXAMPLE USAGE:
- Confirmation: request_user_interaction(message='Read 3 PDFs?', mode='confirmation', level='high')
- Choice: request_user_interaction(message='Which thread?', mode='choice', options=[...])
- Control: request_user_interaction(message='Processing...', mode='control', control_type='pause')

options.description: Button options (auto-generated for control mode). Format: [{label, value, description, insert_text}]

insert_text.description: Text to insert into input field (for text-insert buttons)

allow_custom_input.description: Show text field alongside buttons? User can click button OR type custom text. Default: true

button_behavior.description: Button click behavior: 'submit' (instant send) or 'insert' (populate input field). Control mode always uses 'insert'. Default: 'submit'

control_type.description: If mode='control', specify which buttons: 'pause', 'stop', 'explain', 'continue', or 'all' (default)

estimated_tokens.description: Estimated token cost if user confirms (helps user understand resource usage)

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated dollar cost if user confirms (transparency)

is_destructive.description: Is this operation destructive/irreversible? (adds warning styling)

affected_items.description: List of items that will be affected (files, emails, records, etc.)

input_placeholder.description: Placeholder text for text input field

returns.description: Interaction request that pauses conversation. User responds via button OR text field - both continue conversation with same context.
